items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every point of a quasi-DM algebraic stack has a residual gerbe (author lemma at source lines 7087-7092, label lemma-every-point-residual-gerbe-quasi-DM). The proof (source lines 7094-7162) replaces the stack by the quotient stack of a flat, locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite presentation, restricts that groupoid to the spectra of the residue fields of the points of the presentation lying over the given point, checks that the restricted projections are still locally quasi-finite, flat and locally of finite presentation because the source is a disjoint union of spectra of fields, and concludes that the resulting quotient stack is a monomorphism to the original with singleton image and locally Noetherian reduced source, hence the residual gerbe by uniqueness (proof lines 7095-7161). The restriction of the groupoid with its degree bookkeeping is the content. H3.
